message:
Now I know the exact vulnerability: **Use-of-uninitialized-value in `od_ec_decode_bool_q15`**, called from `av1_read_coeffs_txb` and `av1_read_coeffs_txb_facade`. This is in the entropy decoding of transform coefficients.

The issue was reported on Mar 2, 2024, and the regression range is 202402260625:202402270613. Our HEAD commit is from 2024-02-26, so this is right at the regression point.

Let me look at the fix for this issue. Let me search for commits that fix this specific issue.

<｜｜DSML｜｜>
<parameter=command>cd /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/aom && git log --all --oneline --since="2024-02-26" --until="2024-06-01" --grep="od_ec_decode_bool" | head -10 && echo "---" && git log --all --oneline --since="2024-02-26" --until="2024-06-01" --grep="coeffs_txb" | head -10 && echo "---" && git log --all --oneline --since="2024-02-26" --until="2024-06-01" --grep="entropy" | head -20</｜｜DSML｜｜>
</｜｜DSML｜｜>
